props.name: profile
props.description: Collapsed stacks, one per line: `main;handle;parse 42`. The format Brendan Gregg’s stackcollapse scripts emit.

props.name: baseline
props.description: A second profile in the same format. When given, frames are coloured by how their share changed from it.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Controlled orientation: flame grows up from the root, icicle hangs down from it.

props.name: search
props.description: Controlled search text. Matching frames are highlighted.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the search field, orientation switch and zoom breadcrumb.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of a frame row in pixels.

props.name: unit
props.description: What a sample is called in the tooltip — samples, ms, allocations.
